name: hub-home-tracker-contract
goal: Prove the Hub Home session total follows live Tracker runs when a project also has a flag, while quiet and done projects add no working sessions.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: PR #320 recorded 0 working with 17 live runs. Project-level needs-you took precedence over active and active also included recently touched work.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The Home browser fixture assigned states and sessions directly and never traversed the Tracker read and projection boundary.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Isolated mutation restores the pre-PR #320 state-only working predicate. The strengthened contract fails with expected +0 to be 3.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use the native items and runs response recording for the existing projection test and browser fixture. Keep working sessions tied to live runs and the ask state independent.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: The test-only branch replays the captured responses through readTrackerSources and buildHomeSnapshot in the normal Hub suites. The product correction is already on main.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: All six Hub Home data tests pass with the production predicate restored and the same frozen test inputs.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated state-only mutation reports 0 rather than 3 working sessions; restored source tree is identical to the task test commit.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
